defects.severity: high (write outside the caller's extent; the authority has the same defect and it is not reproduced)
defects.class: zero-length terminator write (AGENTS.md sections 17 and 21.1; same class as M27-D1)
defects.description: file_gets wrote `*buf = 0` before consulting `size`. BIO_gets admits a zero-length request, and for `size == 0` a valid buffer has no writable byte, so the write escaped the caller's extent (and for `BIO_gets(b, NULL, 0)` it dereferenced NULL). `fgets` with a non-positive count is also undefined.
defects.fix: Return the authority's 0 without touching `buf` or `bp` when `size <= 0`; the NULL-buffer guard remains. Control: runtime::bio::bss_file::tests::a_zero_length_gets_does_not_write_through_a_null_buffer.
defects.divergence: Deliberate: for size 0 the buffer is left untouched instead of receiving a byte the caller has no writable extent for. Return value and all size > 0 behaviour are unchanged.

defects.severity: high (NULL dereference inside libc from a C-valid control call; the pinned authority has the same UB)
defects.class: NULL argument handed to a libc dereference (AGENTS.md section 17; D-CIPHERCTX-NOALG-1 policy class)
defects.description: BIO_C_SET_FILENAME built its mode string and called `fopen(ptr_, mode)` with no NULL check. `fopen(NULL, ...)` dereferences the NULL filename inside libc; OpenSSL 4.0.2 later added the refusal, confirming the input class.
defects.fix: Refuse a NULL filename after mode construction and before `fopen`, answering the authority's failure `0`. No new error coordinate is raised, matching this file's existing total-by-policy treatment of NULL arguments in BIO_new_file. Control: runtime::bio::bss_file::tests::set_filename_refuses_a_null_filename.
defects.divergence: Deliberate: a NULL filename is an error return rather than a libc fault. All non-NULL inputs and the error queue for them are unchanged.

defects.severity: low (out-of-authority read and redundant write of embedded storage; no observed behavioural change)
defects.class: unnecessary read/write broadening an initialization precondition (AGENTS.md section 2)
defects.description: template_free read `*pval` unconditionally and, on the ASN1_TFLG_EMBED path, wrote it straight back before substituting the slot's address. The authority never reads an embedded field's storage (`tval = (ASN1_VALUE *)pval; pval = &tval;`), so the transcription imposed an initialization requirement and performed a store the authority does not.
defects.fix: Assign `tval` from the slot's address only on the embed path and drop both the read and the write-back, matching `new.rs`'s existing transcription of the same authority pattern.
defects.divergence: None for any caller: the removed write stored back the value it had just read, and the non-embed path is textually unchanged.

defects.severity: low (fallible signed arithmetic; debug panic in a hand-filled negative-length struct, no conforming-input change)
defects.class: unchecked signed subtraction used for an allocation-adjacent write extent (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: ASN1_BIT_STRING_set_bit tested `w + 1 - s.length > 0` and then wrote `w + 1 - s.length.max(0)` bytes, mixing the unclamped and clamped lengths. For a caller-filled negative `length`, `INT_MIN` could overflow the test even though the surrounding code deliberately clamps the release extent.
defects.fix: Compare and subtract in `usize` against the already-computed clamped `old_len`, keeping the authority's test for every non-negative length while removing the overflow.
defects.divergence: None: for every non-negative length the condition and byte count are identical to the previous transcription.
